about: The lighting rig for Johnny Tremain in Theatre 2 (tools/jt-rig.py writes this file; docs/johnny-tremain/LIGHT-PLOT.md is the plot). pos = the hang point (top of the clamp; for a floor unit the floor under it) and aim = the focus point, both WORLD metres (stage → world: x + 20.00, y + 0.80, z + 2.30). A look entry per unit is [level 0..1, colour hex] and, for a mover, [level, colour, aim (stage x, y, z) or null for its rest focus, gobo]. Universes and addresses are 1-based (as a desk shows them).

interior-night-warm.note: the Dawes kitchen: warm and comic

night-interior-lamp.note: the surgery again: midnight by the lamp, then the dark before dawn at Lexington

night-interior-lantern.note: darkness, the lantern moving, the three reveals
